programme.title: DC 9/11: Time of Crisis
programme.desc: Gideon Banks lost his wife Liz and son Simon in a horrific car accident some twenty years ago. At the time of the accident he was involved in something called the Neural Archiving Project - NAP for short. The technology was developed to create smart computers - transferring human engrams to computers. The company eventually gave up on the technology, but Gideon didn't. After years of quietly perfecting it, he built a small robot, from parts he stole from Concorde Robotics, where he now works. Zoe, Gideon's niece, discovers Gideon's secret, the robot contains actual neural engrams from the real Simon. She becomes worried not only about Gideon but also about the robot that sounds and acts a lot like her little cousin used to.

Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: In 1864, an American Civil War troop struggles to survive when young Union (American Civil War) soldier Jim Rabb (Ryan Merriman) discovers that his mare has given birth to a Colt (horse). A superior officer orders Jim to shoot the foal because it may become a burden, but Jim - seeing the colt as a sign of hope and a reminder of the beauty of life - refuses. The colt remains with the men as they battle. When Confederacy (American Civil War)s overtake the camp and steal the colt, Jim must risk his life retrieving it.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. These adaptations, forged by eons of evolution, give animals the edge they need to outwit predators, rivals, and the elements. From the bombardier beetle's boiling spray to the mantis shrimp's explosive club and the draco lizard's hidden wings, meet nature's awesome secret weapons.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Sixth Sense. To win the game of life, it can take more than brute force. Animals with a super-powered sixth sense can get the edge on fast-moving prey, beat the elements, and find food in unlikely places.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds reveals some highly questionable parenting strategies from the animal kingdom's worst parents, the underdogs. From a goose who lays their eggs on the top of a cliff to a koala that feeds its baby poop, it's uncertain if they bad parents or just misunderstood. But no matter how bad one thinks they may be at parenting; they can't be as bad as these guys.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: In nature, the prevailing rule is "eat or be eaten." Avoiding predators and competition for space, food, and mates is a priority for every animal. But before you can attack, you need to be able to defend yourself. After eons of evolution, animals have developed powerful and surprising defensive techniques that help them avoid, overcome, or escape challengers.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The long-awaited spinoff of the legendary The Incredible Dr. Pol franchise has finally hatched! Spearheaded by Dr. Pol and his son Charles, the Pol familys three generations are all joining forces to grow their animal loving empire and take on an ambitious new project: transforming 350-acres of undeveloped land into a fully functional family farm!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's are preparing for sheep to give birth, which means figuring out how to catch and shear their four Merino ewes - no small task as this is new territory for everyone except Dr. Pol. Then, while helping his dad on a farm call, Charles has a terrifying accident. The whole family rallies together to care for Charles and take care of the farm.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: An expert river guide in Zimbabwe meets more than his match in treacherous waters. Despite repeated maulings that leave him with 38 major bite wounds, he survives to tell his tale. In the Pacific Northwest, a civil servant on a getaway weekend suffers a very uncivilized fate. Ambushed by a hungry animal, he goes toe to toe with his attacker to save himself and his dogs.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!

When her ex-marine combat skills aren't enough to drive off her attacker, a pack of mountain bikers comes to her rescue.

programme.desc: Sunshine, sandy beaches and palm trees - not only does the Caribbean boast them, so too does South Africa's East Coast. Here you are no longer privy to the rocky coastline of the Cape of Good Hope! It is hot and sticky all year round - the mangroves and the bayous in the east of the country present ideal conditions for strange frogs, mudskippers and enormous Nile crocodiles - still, occasionally it's also too hot to handle, even for them!

programme.title: Battle Of the Swamp Dragons
programme.desc: South Florida is the only place on Earth that is home to both the American alligator and the American crocodile (and most recently, the Nile crocodile). But who is the baddest Florida predator? In this croc vs. gator fest, we'll compare the physical characteristics and behavior of these two prehistoric titans in the beautiful backdrop of South Florida to find out who is the true Lord of the Swamp… and identify one species that may threaten his throne.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: On this special episode of "The Incredible Dr. Pol," Michigan's most trusted vets are always on call, because animal emergencies don't wait for business hours. From a cat attacked by a raccoon to a pig struggling with farrowing, the team tackles a wide range of urgent cases — Dr. Pol even heeds the call for a dangerously distressed horse and saves a Chihuahua's vision after a scuffle. With animals in need at all hours, these vets spring into action, improvising and solving problems on the fly. No matter the crisis, Dr. Pol and his dedicated team race to the scene, delivering lifesaving care to animals big and small.

programme.title: Wonders of the Ocean
programme.desc: The wild Pacific covers one third of our planet. It has the most volcanoes, the biggest earthquakes, deepest trenches, and the most islands on Earth. Found in icy sub-Antarctic waters, tropical coral seas, and still smoking volcanic arcs, there is no such thing as a typical Pacific island. The wildest and most bizarre creatures have evolved to thrive on these unique Islands of Life, often surviving nowhere else on Earth.

programme.title: Wonders of the Ocean
programme.desc: The ocean is full of wonders, but creating them has been a bloody battle for over half a billion years, as evermore complex animals fight for survival. They evolved new ways to hunt, overpower and kill and eat each other. And astonishing adaptations to defend themselves, hide and escape detection. Passing those amazing new abilities on to the next generation can be a bruising battle in itself as males fight each other for the right to mate.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Africa's southern coastline hosts some of the most vibrant, varied and dynamic reef systems on the planet. Bizarre, beautiful and mysterious worlds, they are crammed with a bustling diversity of life. Ever changing, these coral gardens are amongst the most competitive and cutthroat of underwater environments. Africa's Deadly Kingdom: Reefs dives in to reveal the astounding adaptations of a multitude of marine creatures to life below the waves.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: Lessons at Panda School are getting tougher. The junior cubs are grappling with hard-to-eat bamboo leaves and attempting to climb trees in the rain. Playtime teaches them to channel their innate clumsiness to build a more resilient bear. The cubs begin to crack the panda code, each showing their true colors and demonstrating what their futures might hold. Dirtbag's wild-at-heart instincts kick in, while Can Yang's extroverted and adaptable nature shines through. A new pair of ambassador pandas prepares for life overseas, while in the maternity unit, the nursery cubs are growing cuter by the day and learning to walk. And up the mountain, the first snows present a challenge for Tian Tian and the cub she's raising for the wild.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: The Kalahari. Land of great thirst. Endless mirages of red and yellow sand merge with a shimmering horizon. Summer rains bring brief explosions of life, painting the landscape in vibrant colours, only to be soaked up by the thirsty earth and returned once again to the desert. In this place of immense beauty, wonder and contrast all that live here are gifted with unique adaptations in order to survive.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: A new class starts at Panda School. Little cubs have spent their whole lives in the maternity unit but will venture outside for the first time into a world full of new sights, new sounds and new Panda Skills to learn. Mini Ling Lang, the oldest of the summer cubs, discovers her mum is an expert climber and tries to take after her. Su Jin Junior is headstrong, and his mom keeps him in line with a no-nonsense teaching style. The little twins are too young to start climbing, but they put their best paw forward when snow arrives. A snow day doesn't mean school is canceled; it means the lessons will be harder. While the littlest cubs are starting their schooling, Tian Tian's cub is up in the mountains and coming to the end of his lessons … inching closer to a life in the wild.

programme.title: Snow School
programme.desc: When every day is a snow day, school is always in session! Snowy climates can make for harsh living, and adulting is hard no matter where you are, but these young are flourishing; a baby walrus gets a swim lesson from Mom, young stoats' playtime teaches them how to hunt, otter pups take a slide and learn to avoid predators, and owlets practice leaving the nest. We'll also see penguin chicks daring to take the leap, an unlikely team of mismatched teenagers, and others learning how to weather and thrive in the coldest climates, thanks to their snowy homeschooling, some very dedicated parents, and a lot of trial and error.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines: Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A nation of more than 100 million people on a collection of over 7,600 islands all set in the warm emerald seas of the Pacific Ocean, the Philippines is a land of sparkling wonder and contrasts.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Big Cat Week
programme.desc: RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER records the battle for survival of the big cats and reveals intimate details of their lives. The animals they prey on are also in the film: tigers couldn't survive without sika deer, Altai wapiti, wild boars and Asian black bears. A young tiger, born in a conservation area, will guide the viewer through the film. RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER accompanies him throughout the year after he leaves his mother. His search for a territory reveals the problems facing tigers in Russia's Far East, and the conflicts that arise when he strays into human settlements. The young tiger takes the viewer to places where the fate of Siberian tigers will be decided: vast forests, remote villages and the cities at the edge of the wilderness.

programme.title: Caught in the Act
programme.desc: Caught in the Act is a television show presenting a collection of remarkable and unexpected animal behavior caught on film, from amazing maternal instincts, to dramatic fights, rescues and competition. A team of experts and the eyewitnesses who made the footage discuss these incredible wildlife moments that make us see the natural world in a different light. These tapes reveal the emotional side of animals, from tragic to hopeful. See how a baby hippo escapes from a shark, a warthhog takes on two lions and much more.

programme.title: Serengeti Speed Queen
programme.desc: Nzuri is the Speed Queen of the Serengeti - but being fast isn't enough. She's constantly bullied by hyenas on the grassland and hunted by lions in the marsh. When two of her cubs are killed, the family is exiled to the transition forest. There, she learns to adapt her hunting methods and adds strategy to speed in order to outwit her enemies and steer her remaining cubs successfully to adulthood.

Maya writes her own rules when it comes to raising a litter, yet motherhood doesn't come easy. One thing is clear, Maya will do whatever it takes to secure her bloodline within the Kingdom of Taru.

programme.title: Living Edens
programme.desc: In the heart of India, a tiger family battles for dominance in the ruins of a lost empire. B1, a young tiger, challenges his aging grandfather for supremacy over their pride land, taking advantage of his slowed reflexes and struggling vision. Meanwhile, B1's mother tries to keep the peace for her new cubs during their risky first years of life, and for her father, who is becoming increasingly helpless. But B1 is bent on taking over and starting his own dynasty deep in the heart of ancient India.

programme.title: The World's Most Famous Tiger
programme.desc: Known as the Queen of Ranthambore, Machli is the most famous tiger in the world. The legendary tigress is a fearsome warrior known for her daring exploits. And she's the mother of an incredible four litters of cubs.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: MAX & THE MIDKNIGHTS is a medieval action-adventure comedy about a girl named Max and her group of friends, the Midknights, as they embark on a quest to help a neighboring kingdom of gnomes and discover that their own kingdom could be in danger.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: "Black School Rules" Sora is a high school student who is basically invisible at school. He is friends with Chuya who is an upredictable character that often surprises those around him. Sora and Chuya both have feelings for the same classmate, Kio Machida. Machida girl refuses to come to class, because she doesn't want to dye her naturally brown hair black. Their school has unreasonable school rules, especially about uniforms which including requiring all students to have black hair. Sora and Chuya decide to stand up to change their school's black school rules so that Machida won't have to repeat a year of school from missing too many classes.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Best friends and cadets-in-training Swift, Penny, Rod, and Brody congregate at Top Wing Academy, where they learn what it takes to gain their wings and become rescue birds on Big Swirl Island. Swift is a blue jay and the fastest pilot at the academy; Penny, the only female in the group, is a penguin, and she is an expert at undersea life; Brody is a puffin who takes a more land approach, and Rod is a rooster who is ready to fly around Big Swirl Island in his all-terrain vehicle. The four friends are joined by their mentor Speedy, who helps the cadets on their different missions. "Top Wing" focuses on the importance of teamwork and the ability to successfully solve problems.

programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The opening of a time capsule buried at the zoo a century ago, forces the penguins, Julien, Maurice, Mort, Marlene and Fred into a search for the legendary cursed treasure of the Golden Squirrel, which they must find and destroy before the rats claim it for themselves, but matters are complicated when the treasure includes a curse that will drive those who seek it to fight each other until one who is "pure of heart" claims the treasure.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: It's Kindness Day! Mr. Guzman announces that if all students complete one act of kindness, they'll get a class pizza party-and Hazel wants that pizza! But when Dev refuses to participate, Cosmo and Wanda call on the Pe-Az, a trio of alien diplomats, to reason with him. Despite their best efforts, Dev outsmarts the Pe-Az and uses their alien technology to get rid of all the pizza on Earth. // Hazel must take matters into her own hands to get to the bottom of Dev's surly attitude and save pizza! When Hazel makes a wish to understand why Dev acts the way he does, she gets paired with him for a class scavenger hunt. They struggle to work together, but, as the day goes on, they develop a friendship. However, that falls apart when Dev's dad, Dale, belittles their effort, causing Dev to turn on Hazel again to save face. Will Dev be able to overcome his pride and finish the project, or will his issues with his dad tank both their grades?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Having filled up another wish card, Hazel is enjoying a fun, fantasy wish. Meanwhile, Cookie, the fairy who got bested by Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda after their Wish Trials, is setting a trap for our trio. She tricks them into publicly talking about magic at a fake museum exhibit, records the evidence, and then takes them to Fairy Court. Now, Hazel must prove that Cosmo and Wanda are innocent, or else lose them forever. // Frustrated by her mom's split attention between work and home, Hazel wishes to be her assistant to spend more time with her. Cosmo and Wanda turn Hazel into an adult, and she spends the day struggling to fulfill her duties. Even though being a working adult is hard, Hazel is excited to be spending so much quality time with Angela. But when the puppet standing in for Hazel at school gets called into the nurse's office, Angela rushes off to take care of it and Hazel must give the presentation instead!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Dev's dad, tech magnate Dale Dimmadome, creates an app designed to track kids' wants at the annual Founder's Day Festival, but Hazel shows up as an anomaly thanks to Cosmo and Wanda's wish granting. Dale programs giant robots to track her down.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

The penguins counter-program Leonard with a Lunacorn love movie marathon - is it enough to conquer all? // Private is left to babysit four adorable ducklings as the rest of the gang tries to crash a monster truck rally (unsuccessfully). programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

How in the world can a traffic jam get cleared out of the tunnel in time? // The penguins make a new friend in Dode the dodo bird, who they clone back into existence after a pesky bout of extinction. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But when Ray's REAL attacker appears, a mutant snapping turtle named TOKKA, he fights everyone... until his watch starts beeping and he escapes. The Turtles tail him, ending up on the Staten Island ferry. After a big fight, Tokka's trapped. But while questioning him, Tokka explodes into OOZE, leaving only a baby turtle and his watch. Donnie's brothers ask him to hack it and find clues about Tokka, which he says is impossible! Later, Donnie gets a location pin from Wingnut and follows it to an abandoned factory on Staten Island. The two enter a partnership looking for ways to spend on the good life. The Red Squirrel has designs on the loot, though, and captures the hapless twosome in order to squeeze the acorns out of them. Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Rampage - Furia animale

Le sue dimensioni, inoltre, aumentano a dismisura. Un esperto di scimmie, Davis Okoye, che aveva stretto un affettuoso rapporto con il primate, vuole vederci chiaro. Indagando sull'accaduto scopre che altri animali sono stati sottoposti allo stesso trattamento. Un lupo e un coccodrillo stanno andando incontro alla medesima alterazione di George: serve al più presto un antidoto per fermare la loro rabbia distruttrice.

programme.desc: Dylan O'Brien e Michael Keaton in un action dal romanzo di Vince Flynn. Sconvolto dalla morte della fidanzata, uccisa in un attentato, uno studente entra nella Cia e diventa un killer.

Quando i passeggeri saranno costretti a un soggiorno forzato a St.Louis a causa di un uragano in arrivo, le due amiche metteranno da parte ogni scrupolo e ogni principio di lealta' pur di sedurre il loro compagno di viaggio in una girandola di imprevisti e brutte figure. programme.desc: Simona Izzo e Ricky Tognazzi raccontano la storia d'amore tra Francesca Morvillo e Giovanni Falcone: un rapporto intenso che li vedrà uniti fino agli ultimi istanti delle loro vite.

programme.desc: Cecilia, una violinista di grande talento costretta a vivere in un orfanotrofio, incontra Vivaldi, che diventa il suo maestro. Grazie alla sua guida e alla sua musica, trova il coraggio di seguire la sua passione.

programme.title: C'e' Ancora Domani
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Paola Cortellesi, anche protagonista, entrato nella storia del cinema italiano. Roma,1946: Delia ha accettato la sua vita ma spera in un futuro migliore per la figlia.

programme.title: Il socio
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di John Grisham, thriller di Sydney Pollack con Gene Hackman e Tom Cruise. Assunto da un prestigioso studio legale, un avvocato inesperto viene coinvolto in loschi intrighi.

programme.title: Fa' la cosa giusta
programme.desc: Danny Aiello, Samuel L. Jackson e John Turturro nel film che ha consacrato il talento di Spike Lee. In un torrido giorno estivo, a Brooklyn, esplode lo scontro fra afroamericani e italiani.

programme.title: Nel nome del padre

programme.desc: Danny Aiello, Samuel L. Jackson e John Turturro nel film che ha consacrato il talento di Spike Lee. In un torrido giorno estivo, a Brooklyn, esplode lo scontro fra afroamericani e italiani.

Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.desc: Tim Robbins e Morgan Freeman nel dramma carcerario tratto da Stephen King. Mentre sogna la fuga, un bancario condannato per omicidio stringe una grande amicizia con un altro detenuto.

programme.title: Rock Dog 2
programme.desc: Animazione rockeggiante Sky Original. Bodi e la sua band sono ormai gli idoli di Snow Mountain. Quando un impresario li scrittura per un tour scopriranno che la fama ha un prezzo.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

programme.title: Bambi - Una vita nei boschi
programme.desc: Un piccolo cerbiatto di nome Bambi è appena venuto al mondo. Con l'aiuto dei suoi amici, Bambi vivrà ogni tipo di avventura che lo preparerà ad assumere il suo ruolo di principe della foresta.

programme.title: Ops! È già Natale

In un continuo crescendo di violenze e ingiustizie scoppia la rivolta dei detenuti, che eleggono Irving come loro capo. programme.desc: Un agente dell'FBI sposato da poco deve cercare informazioni in una cittadina del Kentucky. L'uomo inizia una relazione con una donna del posto, la quale diventa la sua principale fonte d'informazione. La giovane vede in lui un modo per fuggire.

programme.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
programme.desc: Josh Hutcherson ed Elizabeth Lail nel sequel horror prodotto dalla Blumhouse. Mentre i macabri fatti avvenuti al Freddy Fazbear's sono diventati una leggenda locale, nuovi e terrificanti eventi si abbattono su Mike e Vanessa, portando alla luce un orrore a lungo nascosto.

programme.title: The Prestige
programme.desc: Meraviglia e suspense con Hugh Jackman e Christian Bale, per la regia di Christopher Nolan. La Londra di fine 800 fa da sfondo all'accesa e ossessiva rivalita' tra due illusionisti.

programme.title: Out of Sight
programme.desc: George Clooney e Jennifer Lopez in un thriller di Steven Soderbergh, tratto da un romanzo di Elmore Leonard. Un rapinatore gentiluomo evade dal carcere e prende in ostaggio una poliziotta.

programme.title: Assassinio sull'Orient Express
programme.desc: Kenneth Branagh dirige un super cast con Michelle Pfeiffer, Penelope Cruz e Johnny Depp. Il detective Poirot indaga su un omicidio avvenuto su un treno. Dal bestseller di Agatha Christie.

programme.title: Ida Red
programme.desc: Crime-thriller con Frank Grillo, Josh Hartnett e Melissa Leo. In prigione per omicidio, la matriarca di una famiglia del crimine tesse le fila della malavita dal carcere.

programme.title: Last Breath
programme.desc: La storia vera di un gruppo di palombari esperti, che sfidano la natura per salvare un compagno di equipaggio rimasto intrappolato a centinaia di metri sotto la superficie dell'oceano.

programme.title: Psyco
programme.desc: Lezione di suspense e paura per la regia di Alfred Hitchcock, con Anthony Perkins, Vera Miles e Janet Leigh. Una donna in fuga arriva nel tetro motel gestito dall'inquietante Norman Bates.

programme.title: Dead Shot - Vendetta disperata
programme.desc: Revenge movie targato Sky Original con Colin Morgan, Felicity Jones e Mark Strong. Sopravvissuto all'assassinio della moglie incinta, a un ex paramilitare non resta che la vendetta.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman e Antonio Banderas in un thriller mozzafiato. Un esperto ladro internazionale recluta un giovane 'collega' per mettere a segno l'ultimo colpo della sua carriera.

programme.title: God is a Bullet
programme.desc: Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Maika Monroe e Jamie Foxx nel film Sky Original di Nick Cassavetes. Per salvare la figlia, il detective Bob Hightower si infiltra in una setta satanica.

programme.title: The Hanging Sun - Sole di mezzanotte
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jo Nesbo, Sky Original di Francesco Carrozzini con Alessandro Borghi. In fuga verso l'estremo Nord, John conosce Lea e Caleb, unica speranza di salvezza da un destino segnato.

programme.title: Io sono leggenda
programme.desc: Cult di fantascienza con Will Smith. Un virus ha decimato l'umanita' trasformando i superstiti in mostri. Uno scienziato immune al morbo studia una cura nel suo laboratorio.

programme.title: The Hanging Sun - Sole di mezzanotte
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jo Nesbo, Sky Original di Francesco Carrozzini con Alessandro Borghi. In fuga verso l'estremo Nord, John conosce Lea e Caleb, unica speranza di salvezza da un destino segnato.

programme.title: Pig, il piano di Rob
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage in un film ambientato nelle impervie lande dell’Oregon. Un solitario cacciatore di tartufi vive nella sua fattoria in compagnia dell’amata e preziosa scrofa. Quando l’animale viene rapito, l’uomo si mette in viaggio verso i luoghi del suo passato per ritrovarlo.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Garry Marshall (Pretty Woman) dirige una commedia con Jennifer Aniston, Kate Hudson e Julia Roberts. La festa della mamma intreccia i destini di 4 donne fra amori e segreti da nascondere.

programme.title: Cuori ribelli
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Nicole Kidman nel dramma romantico di Ron Howard. Due giovani irlandesi, Shannon e Joseph, si trasferiscono a Boston in cerca di fortuna affrontando mille peripezie.

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.title: Terapia di coppia per amanti
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini, Pietro Sermonti e Sergio Rubini in una deliziosa commedia sui tormenti amorosi. Viviana e Modesto, entrambi sposati e con un figlio a testa, sono amanti clandestini da lungo tempo ma la loro relazione sta diventando sempre più complicata ai limiti dell’esasperazione. Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Ma Viviana e Modesto non sono una coppia, almeno ufficialmente. Tratto dall’omonimo romanzo di Diego De Silva, autore della sceneggiatura con il regista Alessio Maria Federici.

programme.title: L'amore non va in vacanza
programme.desc: Commedia romantica con Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law e Jack Black. Deluse dall’amore, due donne si scambiano l’appartamento andando incontro a nuove opportunità.

programme.title: Lei
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe 2014 alla sceneggiatura per lo struggente racconto di una love story incredibile. Il solitario Theodore (Joaquin Phoenix) si innamora della voce di un sofisticato computer (Scarlett Johansson nella versione originale e Micaela Ramazzotti in quella italiana).

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: Clive Owen e Julia Roberts in una commedia intessuta di doppio gioco. Due spie industriali, ex agenti segreti ed ex amanti, uniscono i loro intenti per impadronirsi di una formula segreta.

programme.title: Come fratelli
programme.desc: Due amiche rimangono incinte contemporaneamente e muoiono in un incidente. I loro rispettivi mariti, lasciati soli ad affrontare la sfida di essere padri e vedovi, decidono di unire i loro sforzi per crescere i figli.

programme.title: Book Club - Tutto puo' succedere
programme.desc: Diane Keaton e Jane Fonda guidano un cast di superstar hollywoodiane in una commedia spensierata sulla riscoperta della sessualita'. Quattro amiche che da tantissimi anni amano discutere di libri, decidono di calarsi nella lettura di uno dei fenomeni letterari del ventunesimo secolo: il famigerato romanzo erotico "Cinquanta sfumature di grigio". Scorrere quelle pagine piccanti, sviscerarne ogni dettaglio non le lascera' affatto indifferenti ma le spingera' ad assecondare le loro piu' capricciose curiosita', cogliendo l'occasione per dare una svolta alla loro routine.

programme.title: L'amore non va in vacanza
programme.desc: Commedia romantica con Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law e Jack Black. Deluse dall’amore, due donne si scambiano l’appartamento andando incontro a nuove opportunità.

programme.title: Una sirena a Parigi
programme.desc: Marilyn Lima e Nicolas Duvauchelle in una magica avventura su un amore impossibile. Un cantante si prende cura di una sirena ferita, ma cade vittima della sua voce ammaliante.

programme.title: Bianco Natale
programme.desc: Bing Crosby e Danny Kaye in un classico irrinunciabile. Due artisti di varietà vengono scritturati per un musical natalizio dal loro vecchio comandante sull'orlo del fallimento.

programme.title: La quattordicesima domenica del tempo ordinario
programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Lodo Guenzi, Edwige Fenech e Gabriele Lavia in una storia sul tempo perduto. L'incontro fra due ex amanti riporta alla luce sogni e disillusioni.

programme.title: The Wedding Planner - Prima o poi mi sposo
programme.desc: Commedia romantica con Jennifer Lopez e Matthew McConaughey. Un'organizzatrice di matrimoni rimane colpita dal fascino di un pediatra, ma scopre che e' il promesso sposo di una sua cliente.

programme.title: Ti Odio, Ti Lascio, Ti...
programme.desc: Commedia romantica con Vince Vaughn e Jennifer Aniston. Dopo l'ennesimo diverbio, Gary e Brooke decidono di lasciarsi ma nessuno dei due e' intenzionato ad abbandonare il tetto coniugale.

programme.title: Book Club - Tutto puo' succedere
programme.desc: Diane Keaton e Jane Fonda guidano un cast di superstar hollywoodiane in una commedia spensierata sulla riscoperta della sessualita'. Quattro amiche che da tantissimi anni amano discutere di libri, decidono di calarsi nella lettura di uno dei fenomeni letterari del ventunesimo secolo: il famigerato romanzo erotico "Cinquanta sfumature di grigio". programme.title: Quel mostro di suocera
programme.desc: Jennifer Lopez e Jane Fonda in una brillante commedia a tinte rosa. Una ragazza sta per sposare l'uomo ideale, ma l'invadente futura suocera farà di tutto per renderle la vita un inferno.

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

programme.title: One for the Money
programme.desc: Divertente commedia con la star di "Grey's Anatomy" Katherine Heigl. Fresca di divorzio, Stephanie si ritrova senza lavoro a vivere in compagnia del suo criceto. Accetta così di diventare cacciatrice di taglie, per rintracciare quelle persone che devono dei soldi al cugino. Il suo primo incarico è ritrovare un ex poliziotto accusato di omicidio che, guarda il caso, ai tempi del liceo le aveva spezzato il cuore. Grazie all'aiuto di un collega riuscirà a farsi strada in un mondo decisamente maschile. La Heigl è anche produttrice del film.

programme.title: Una sirena a Parigi
programme.desc: Marilyn Lima e Nicolas Duvauchelle in una magica avventura su un amore impossibile. Un cantante si prende cura di una sirena ferita, ma cade vittima della sua voce ammaliante.

programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia di Guido Chiesa. Un uomo divorziato deve nascondere l'esistenza della figlia per conquistare una donna che detesta i bambini.

programme.title: Intervista A Edoardo Leo - Ep. 476 - Intervista A Edoardo Leo
programme.desc: Intervista A Edoardo Leo - In occasione dell'uscita in sala del nuovo film di Massimiliano Bruno, Francesco Castelnuovo intervista il protagonista maschile, Edoardo Leo, che ci racconta aneddoti dal set.

programme.title: Downton Abbey II - Una nuova era
programme.desc: Secondo film dedicato all'omonima serie. La famiglia Crawley si trasferisce in Costa Azzurra, mentre Lady Mary rimane nella tenuta di Downton Abbey, scelta come location per un film.

programme.title: Rifkin's Festival
programme.desc: Woody Allen dirige Gina Gershon e Louis Garrel in una commedia che racconta le vicissitudini di un ex insegnante di cinema, al seguito della moglie al Festival di San Sebastian.

programme.title: Tumbledown
programme.desc: Rebecca Hall e Jason Sudeikis fra i paesaggi dei Maine in una commedia sul senso della perdita. Hannah, la giovane vedova dell'acclamato folk singer Hunter Miles, sta scrivendo la biografia del defunto marito nel tentativo di elaborare il lutto che la tormenta. Alla stesura collabora Andrew, uno scrittore e professore universitario che cerchera' di incrinare il guscio di rabbia e solitudine in cui Hannah si e' rinchiusa. Non solo per ultimare il libro, ma soprattutto per aiutarla a rifarsi una vita. Opera prima di Sean Mewshaw, assistente alla regia di Martin Scorsese in "Gangs of New York".

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si sfidano a colpi di risate per raccontarci i film campioni d'incassi con Checco Zalone protagonista, disponibili su Sky Cinema e On Demand. (ITA 2025).

programme.title: Les Mise'rables
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 3 Golden Globe al dramma musicale con Hugh Jackman, Anne Hathaway e Russell Crowe, dal romanzo di Victor Hugo. Un ex detenuto si riscostruisce una nuova vita sotto falso nome.

programme.title: Mia moglie è un fantasma
programme.desc: Brillante commedia con Dan Stevens, Leslie Mann, Isla Fisher e Judi Dench basata sull’omonimo racconto. Per uscire dal blocco creativo, uno scrittore si rivolge a un’eccentrica medium, che rievoca lo spirito dell’ex moglie. Questa presenza susciterà le gelosie dell’attuale consorte.

programme.title: C'è post@ per te
programme.desc: Meg Ryan e Tom Hanks in un classico della commedia romantica. La proprietaria di una libreria flirta in rete con uno sconosciuto. Scoprira' che si tratta del suo rivale in affari.

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Dall'omonima serie tv di grande successo, i sofisticati intrighi della famiglia Crawley. Gli aristocratici padroni di casa si mobilitano per l'imminente visita dei reali d’Inghilterra.

programme.desc: Nel terzo capitolo della saga tratta dall'omonimo period drama televisivo, gli aristocratici Crawley affrontano lo scandalo pubblico scoppiato per il divorzio di Lady Mary, candidata a prendere in mano le redini della famiglia.

programme.desc: Lea e Rocco, amanti segreti, vedono la loro relazione cambiare radicalmente, quando Lea diventa ossessiva e cerca di inserirsi nella vita quotidiana di Rocco.

programme.desc: Emozionante film Sky Original di e con Edoardo Leo affiancato da Marta Nieto, Claudia Gerini e Stefano Fresi. Due coppie affrontano il momento più delicato della loro lunga vita insieme.

programme.title: Vi presento Joe Black
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins e Brad Pitt in una suggestiva pellicola sull'amore e la morte. Un miliardario accoglie il tenebroso fidanzato della figlia, ma è ignaro della sua vera identità.

programme.title: Un giorno come tanti
programme.desc: Jason Reitman dirige Kate Winslet, Josh Brolin e Tobey Maguire in un film dal romanzo di Joyce Maynard. Abbandonata dal marito con un figlio adolescente, Adele accoglie in casa un evaso.

programme.title: L'amore, in teoria
programme.desc: Una commedia sentimentale di Luca Lucini con Nicolas Maupas. Un brillante studente di filosofia viene ingiustamente accusato di un reato che non ha commesso e condannato ai servizi sociali, dove incontra Flor, un'attivista che gli cambiera' la vita.

programme.title: Le parole che non ti ho detto
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Nicholas Sparks, un dramma sentimentale con Kevin Costner, Robin Wright e Paul Newman. Da quando è morta la moglie, Garrett Blake ha perso ogni entusiasmo per la vita. Theresa Osbourne è una giornalista che ha trovato un messaggio in una bottiglia sulla spiaggia, firmato "G". Colpita dalle parole appassionate del testo, si mette sulle tracce di quell'uomo misterioso che affida al mare i suoi messaggi d'amore. Fino in North Carolina, dove vive un costruttore di barche con un doloroso passato da dimenticare.

programme.title: Lasciarsi un giorno a Roma
programme.desc: Emozionante film Sky Original di e con Edoardo Leo affiancato da Marta Nieto, Claudia Gerini e Stefano Fresi. Due coppie affrontano il momento più delicato della loro lunga vita insieme.

programme.title: The Colour Room
programme.desc: Phoebe Dynevor nel biopic targato Sky Original, diretto da Claire McCarthy. La storia della rivoluzionaria artista della ceramica Clarice Cliff, una delle prime esponenti dell'Art Deco.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di grigio
programme.desc: Eros e romanticismo per Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan, dal romanzo di E. L. James. Una studentessa viene sedotta da un uomo ricco e misterioso, che la coinvolge in un rapporto trasgressivo.

programme.title: Il dio dell'amore
programme.desc: In una realtà sospesa tra sogno e quotidiano, il film esplora i confini del sentimento più puro. Un viaggio onirico e poetico che mette a nudo la fragilità umana di fronte alla forza travolgente del destino.

programme.title: Tre amiche
programme.desc: Un cast al femminile capitanato da Camille Cottin in un film presentato in concorso a Venezia. Le dinamiche sentimentali di 3 quarantenni vengono sconvolte da un evento inaspettato.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di nero
programme.desc: Tornano Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan nelle avventure sentimental-erotiche tratte dal secondo capitolo della bollente saga letteraria di E. L. James. Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.title: The Colour Room
programme.desc: Phoebe Dynevor nel biopic targato Sky Original, diretto da Claire McCarthy. La storia della rivoluzionaria artista della ceramica Clarice Cliff, una delle prime esponenti dell'Art Deco.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista sudcoreano, disponibili su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: Paternal Leave
programme.desc: Juli Grabenhenrich e Luca Marinelli in un dramma familiare scritto e diretto da Alissa Jung. Una quindicenne tedesca giunge a Rimini per incontrare finalmente il padre biologico italiano, confrontandosi con l'uomo vulnerabile e tormentato che non l'ha mai voluta conoscere.

programme.title: Al di la' dei sogni
programme.desc: Toccante film soprannaturale con Robin Williams. Un uomo viaggia dal Paradiso all'Inferno per salvare la moglie suicida, condannata alla dannazione eterna. Oscar agli effetti speciali.

programme.title: Enzo
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino in una lucida analisi sul bisogno di trovare un posto nel mondo. Enzo, 16 anni, decide di abbandonare la scuola e una vita agiata per diventare muratore.

programme.title: Testa o croce?
programme.desc: Roma, inizi del 1900: lo spettacolo di Buffalo Bill infiamma gli animi e la moglie di un signorotto locale s'innamora del buttero vincitore di una mitica sfida contro i cowboy. I due fuggono insieme, ma con una taglia che pende sulla testa dell'uomo.

programme.title: The Fabelmans
programme.desc: Michelle Williams e Paul Dano nel film piu' intimo e autobiografico di Steven Spielberg. Quando l'armonia della sua famiglia si incrina, Sammy si rifugia nella settima arte.

programme.title: La Voce Di Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Il 29 gennaio 2024 gli operatori della Mezzaluna rossa ricevono la telefonata di Liyan Hamada, una quindicenne di Gaza intrappolata in macchina assieme a Hind Rajab, sua cugina di cinque anni, a seguito dell'attacco di un carro armato israeliano.

programme.title: Il ladro di giorni
programme.desc: Guido Lombardi dirige un road movie con Riccardo Scamarcio e Massimo Popolizio. Uscito di prigione, Vincenzo riallaccia i rapporti con il figlio durante un viaggio dal nord fino in Puglia.

programme.title: Siccita'
programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello al film di Paolo Virzi' con un grande cast corale. In una Roma in cui non piove da tre anni, fra divieti e disagi, si incrociano i destini di un gruppo di individui.

programme.title: Mimì - Il principe delle tenebre
programme.desc: Brando De Sica scrive e dirige un'originale pellicola con Domenico Cuomo e Sara Ciocca. Una malformazione rende Mimì bersaglio di angherie, ma l'incontro con Carmilla cambia tutto.

programme.title: Ogni cosa è illuminata
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Liev Schreiber nel cult on the road con Elijah Wood. Un giovane americano intraprende un viaggio in Ucraina alla ricerca della donna che salvò suo nonno dai nazisti.

programme.title: Io e Lulù
programme.desc: Road movie di e con Channing Tatum, alla sua opera prima. Un ex ranger dell'esercito americano deve portare Lulu', cagnolina esperta in missioni belliche, al funerale del suo padrone.

programme.title: Mimì - Il principe delle tenebre
programme.desc: Brando De Sica scrive e dirige un'originale pellicola con Domenico Cuomo e Sara Ciocca. Una malformazione rende Mimì bersaglio di angherie, ma l'incontro con Carmilla cambia tutto.

programme.title: Scomode verità
programme.desc: Mike Leigh dirige un potente dramma con Marianne Jean-Baptiste e Michele Austin. Pansy, una donna astiosa e irascibile, sempre in conflitto con il mondo, trova finalmente la forza di confessare il segreto che ferisce il suo animo durante una riunione di famiglia.

programme.title: Atlas
programme.desc: Niccolò Castelli dirige Matilda De Angelis nel ruolo di una donna che reagisce a un tragico evento. Marocco: quattro amici appassionati di arrampicata, rimangono coinvolti in un attentato.

programme.title: L'amico fedele
programme.desc: Naomi Watts e Bill Murray in un toccante dramma dal romanzo di Sigrid Nunez. New York: una scrittrice prende in custodia l'amato alano del suo caro amico scomparso, iniziando insieme all'animale un sorprendente percorso verso l'accettazione del lutto e la guarigione.

programme.desc: Cuore, passione e dramma. Il trionfo dell'Arsenal, l'addio di Guardiola al City, i successi in campo europeo di Aston Villa e Palace. Riviviamo una stagione entusiasmante.

programme.title: Mo Salah - When I Was A King
programme.desc: Dopo nove stagioni, Mo Salah saluta il Liverpool. Compagni di squadra e allenatori, attuali e passati, omaggiano l'attaccante egiziano, 257 gol con la maglia dei Reds.

programme.title: Lippi
programme.desc: Giorgio Porrà racconta Marcello Lippi: il suo mare, le sue radici, Vialli e la Juve che nel 1996 conquistò la Champions, preludio al trionfo Mondiale del 2006.

programme.title: Review Of The Season
programme.desc: L'attenzione è rivolta alla finale tra Paris Saint Germain e Arsenal, giocata alla Puskás Aréna di Budapest. Un'occasione per rivivere momenti salienti, interviste esclusive ai protagonisti e retroscena della massima competizione europea.

programme.title: Calciomercato - L'originale
programme.desc: Curiosità, commenti, notizie e anticipazioni sui possibili movimenti del calciomercato. Condotto dal trio Alessandro Bonan, Gianluca Di Marzio e Fayna.

programme.title: Premier League: La Nuova Stagione
programme.desc: Premier League, La Nuova Stagione...

programme.title: La Coppa dei Campioni
programme.desc: Il pretesto, la nascita del format e tutti i retroscena che nel 1956 portarono a disputare la prima finale di Coppa dei Campioni, ora Champions League.

programme.title: Milan - Steaua Bucarest 1989
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League Story: Milan - Steaua Bucarest 1989. Finale - La finale di Coppa dei Campioni giocata al Camp Nou di Barcellona il 24 maggio 1989 con i rossoneri allenati da Sacchi che vincono 4-0 con doppiette di Gullit e Van Basten.

programme.title: Roma - Feyenoord
programme.desc: UEFA Europa Conference League: Roma - Feyenoord. Finale - Ultima finale dei giallorossi nel 1991 in coppa UEFA, persa contro l'Inter. Roma imbattuta nei 2 precedenti di Europa League del 2015, 1 vittoria e 1 pari. TC: Gentile-Bergomi.

programme.title: Ep. 11
programme.desc: Ep11 - Nel 2009 Messi sfida Cristiano Ronaldo e il Barcellona vince la Champions battendo il Manchester United. Derby spagnolo nel 2000 con il Real Madrid che batte il Valencia.

programme.desc: Seiya Kanie, a handsome, scholastically successful and athletic high school student, freaks out when his classmate, Isuzu Sento, points a musket at him and demands he take her on a date to an amusement park.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya must accept the reality of his situation after learning that residents of the magic nation of Maple Land operate the park and receiving the ability to hear people's minds by its owner, Queen Latifah.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Circumstances land Seiya the position of acting owner for the park; he proposes reforms to meet the goal of attracting 250,000 visitors within three months, but the crew has a lot of complaints.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Though arrogant, Seiya solves problem after problem at the park; Isuzu wants to be happy about it, but something bothers her.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: With the 30-yen offer, the number of visitors slowly improves, but money remains an issue; attempting to find quick cash, Seiya visits Moffle, and they set off to search for a supposed treasure hidden in a cave.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Isuzu has mixed feelings about Seiya's expert handling of the issues at the park, even having nightmares about her own work; she resolves to fix the labor shortage by interviewing potential hires.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Summer arrives and Splash Ocean, the water park area, buzzes with guests; Isuzu, Muse and the other four fairies wear pirate costumes; Joe the shark notices something wrong in the machine room.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya collapses from fatigue and a cold after busily managing the park for the past few days; Seiya worries about his attendance at school, so Moffle and others pretend to be Seiya by wearing Mogoot Clan's magical clone suit and going to school.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Muse and others practice for a new show, but have trouble coordinating; Latifah decides to host a sukiyaki party to deepen their friendship.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: The staff tries to put together a promotional video to attract more visitors to the park.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya becomes more determined than ever after finding out Latifah's secret; he comes up with an idea that will help them achieve the target visitor count before the predetermined deadline and orders Tricen, the head of sales, to gather information.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.sub-title: No One Can Predict the Future!
programme.desc: The park sets a new attendance record after being selected as the venue for a soccer match; as visitors file through the entrance gates, Latifah prays for them to achieve the target visitor count; Seiya makes an announcement about the land they sold.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Attendance increases after the park renovates some of the attractions and starts night parades, but Seiya grimly wonders if they can reach the target visitor count before the deadline.
